title: Build a Simple FAQ Chatbot: Questions, Answers and Limits | Ep 43
description:
Build a Simple FAQ Chatbot: Questions, Answers and Limits. Learn with a simple example and a beginner exercise.

AI for Beginners — Episode 43 of 50

What you will learn: Combine a small faq with a question-answer interface.
Example: answering opening hours from a sample FAQ.
Try it: write five FAQ entries and test unknown questions.
Remember: the bot must admit when the FAQ lacks an answer.

Follow the series in episode order and practice with sample data. Share your question or exercise result in the comments.
